title: Performance regression in generic object permission lookups after upgrade (cast on `object_pk` causes high DB CPU)
author: Natgho
body_preview: After upgrading from older `django-guardian` versions to newer 3.x releases, we observed a performance regression in object permission queries using generic permission models.
